item.title: Verbose beta 302
item.description:
Names and titles for calls without an invite

Mac

  • A FaceTime or Zoom call with one other person suggests the name its window showed. Verbose reads the call window through Accessibility while it records. Use or Dismiss the name; nothing renames on its own. With Contacts allowed, the contact's spelling wins.
  • When a call ends with the other side unnamed, type a name or pick one from Contacts. It sits under the transcript's title. The name replaces FaceTime or Speaker 2 throughout the transcript. Dismiss hides it for that call.
  • Calls without a calendar title get the meeting's name or an Apple Intelligence title. Meet, Teams, Zoom, and Webex window titles name the call. Otherwise Apple Intelligence titles it from the summary, and naming the other person can add "with Dana". Titles you typed stay.
